title: Class 3 practice paper
note: Patterns change from year to year. Check the current one on the organiser's site and edit this file — nothing else needs changing.

sections.name: Logical Reasoning
sections.blurb: Series, odd one out, analogies, places in a row, directions, codes and calendars — the part a school textbook never covers.

sections.name: Mathematical Reasoning
sections.blurb: Class 3 maths asked sideways: making the biggest number, missing digits, divisibility, perimeter, fractions of amounts and reading tables.

sections.name: Everyday Mathematics
sections.blurb: Shopping bills and change, bus times, packing boxes, recipes, saving up, and whether an answer sounds sensible.

sections.name: Achievers
sections.blurb: Fewer questions, two things to hold in your head at once. These are the ones that separate the top scores.
